analyzed_vuln.description: The PoV triggers a crash because the fuzz harness unconditionally calls `c.close(&c)` after `UA_Server_processBinaryMessage`. During message processing, `UA_Server_processBinaryMessage` may already call `connection->close(connection)` on parse/protocol errors. In this harness, `close` is `dummyClose`, which frees shared buffers; calling it again from the harness causes a double-close/double-free style memory corruption that leads to a wild control-flow crash (UBSan SEGV in libc).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input is fed to `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`, copied into `msg`, and passed to `UA_Server_processBinaryMessage`. The crafted binary stream must cause `UA_Connection_processChunks` to return an error so `UA_Server_processBinaryMessage` executes its error path (`connection->close(connection)`). After returning, the harness still executes `c.close(&c)` and `UA_Connection_deleteMembers(&c)`, resulting in repeated cleanup on the same connection-owned buffers and crash.
